title: Pink Halloween Coffee Bar
description: Create a pink Halloween coffee corner with a ghost mug, heart-shaped stand, mini velvet pumpkins, silver disco balls and LED tea lights.
intro: A smiling pink ghost mug, a heart-shaped stand and a few sparkling details bring Halloween to the coffee corner. Leave room for your morning routine, then add soft pumpkins and a little LED glow.

sections.heading: Make room for the coffee first
paragraphs: Choose a corner that leaves the machine, water tank and space for setting down a drink easy to reach. Put the ghost mug nearby with its face turned toward the room. A tray or short stretch of counter works just as well as a whole nook.
The machine, cabinetry and countertop belong to the setting; they are not listed products. Build around the coffee routine you already have.

sections.heading: Give the heart stand breathing room
paragraphs: Turn the heart-shaped plates toward the front. Gather a few velvet pumpkins on the lower tier and silver disco balls above, leaving the pink ceramic visible around the edges.

The photographs use selected pieces from the multipacks. Mix the blush, coral pink, peach and ivory tones, keeping smaller mirror balls away from the counter edge. Check the actual stand measurements against your space.

sections.heading: Keep the glow small
paragraphs: Place a few pink LED tea lights around the base of the stand, with a clear spot beside them for your mug. The white flame-shaped tips are plastic LEDs, not real flames. Keep lights and loose decorations away from splashes and the machine.
A coaster, folded towel or container for coffee pods can join the scene. Keep those everyday pieces accessible without reaching through decorations.

sections.heading: Use your own collected extras
paragraphs: The wider view shows Tommy Kate stirring coffee, with the heart stand beside her. It is a useful reminder to leave room for moving, making a drink and setting things down.

The flowers, mirrors, artwork, canisters, cookies and coffee-pod cauldron are optional extras, separate from the five listed finds. A favorite frame or a vase from home makes the corner yours. Use the actual retail photographs and measurements when planning.
